questions.question: What did Hezekiah do with Sennacherib's threatening letter?
options: Hid it away in secret and told absolutely no one at all
Burned it up at once in the heat of his great anger
Spread it before the LORD in the temple and prayed
Sent it straight back to him with a bold and defiant reply
questions.answer: Spread it before the LORD in the temple and prayed

questions.question: How was the Assyrian army defeated in Isaiah 37?
options: A great and sudden storm scattered the whole besieging army
A severe famine forced all of the Assyrians to withdraw at last
The angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 in the camp
Hezekiah's own soldiers drove them all off in a great battle
questions.answer: The angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 in the camp

questions.question: Sennacherib returned to Nineveh and was later killed by his own sons.
Isaiah sent word that the LORD would defend this city to save it, for his own sake and for the sake of his servant _____.
